# Build configuration and provenance
date: 2026-08-27T12:03:17Z

=== source provenance ===
board source tree transferred via: git archive 8f49eae32bdec3674a9a98ea1524a85cd1f302db | tar xf - -C ~/onednn-verify/src
(exported from the local audit repo on 2026-08-27; no modifications)

=== cmake configure (release) ===
cmake -S src -B build-rel -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
  -DONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DONEDNN_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH=OFF \
  -DONEDNN_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE="PRELU;REDUCTION;SHUFFLE"
build: ninja -C build-rel benchdnn -j 8   (371 steps, ~42 min)

=== cmake configure (debug) ===
cmake -S src -B build-dbg -G Ninja \
  -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug \
  -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache \
  -DONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS=ON -DONEDNN_BUILD_EXAMPLES=OFF -DONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH=OFF \
  -DONEDNN_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE="PRELU;REDUCTION;SHUFFLE"
build: ninja -C build-dbg benchdnn -j 8   (371 steps, ~25 min, ccache warm)

=== CMakeCache key entries (release) ===
CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Release
CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER:FILEPATH=/usr/bin/c++
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS:STRING=
ONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH:BOOL=OFF
ONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS:BOOL=ON
ONEDNN_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE:STRING=PRELU;REDUCTION;SHUFFLE
//Alias for ONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH
//Alias for ONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS
=== CMakeCache key entries (debug) ===
CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE:STRING=Debug
CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER:FILEPATH=/usr/bin/c++
CMAKE_CXX_FLAGS:STRING=
ONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH:BOOL=OFF
ONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS:BOOL=ON
ONEDNN_ENABLE_PRIMITIVE:STRING=PRELU;REDUCTION;SHUFFLE
//Alias for ONEDNN_BUILD_GRAPH
//Alias for ONEDNN_BUILD_TESTS

=== probe build commands (all compiled on board) ===
# C++ probes link against the release build (rpath-pinned):
g++ -O2 -g -std=c++17 -fopenmp -I src/include -I build-rel/include \
    dynval/<name>.cpp -o dynval/<name> -L build-rel/src -ldnnl -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/build-rel/src
  -> reduction_tail_probe, prelu_nan_probe, shuffle_zero_batch_probe
# C API probe:
g++ -O1 -g -std=c++17 -I src/include -I build-rel/include \
    dynval/shuffle_c_probe.c -o dynval/shuffle_c_probe -L build-rel/src -ldnnl -Wl,-rpath,$PWD/build-rel/src
# microbenchmarks (no dnnl dependency):
gcc -march=rv64gcv -O1 -o dynval/vta_probe dynval/vta_probe.c
gcc -O2 -o dynval/divzero_probe dynval/divzero_probe.c
gcc -O2 -o dynval/zvfbfwma_probe dynval/zvfbfwma_probe.c
# note: probes are linked against build-rel; the debug-library runs of
#       shuffle probes switch LD_LIBRARY_PATH to build-dbg/src (same soname).
